nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Ownable; controls onlyOwner restricted functions.
Immutable IERC20 token held by the timelock contract.
Immutable beneficiary address that receives released tokens.
Immutable timestamp before which no tokens are released.
Timestamp after which the full benefit is vested; mutated by terminate().
Total vesting benefit amount; reduced on terminate().
Running total of tokens already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating the timelock has been terminated by the owner.
Constant 86400 used for day-based vesting math.
SupervisedTimelock constructor initializing token, beneficiary, vesting window and total benefit.
View function computing the vested amount based on block.timestamp and vesting schedule.
View function returning totalBenefit minus releasedBalance.
Public withdraw of vested tokens to the beneficiary using safeTransfer.
Owner-only function terminating the schedule and sweeping unreleased tokens to the owner.
View getter returning the already withdrawn balance.
View getter returning the held IERC20 token.
View getter returning the beneficiary address.
View getter returning the total benefit.
View getter returning the current owner address.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner.
onlyOwner function renouncing ownership by setting owner to zero.
Private helper writing the owner state variable and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller identity used in ownership checks.
block.timestamp, miner-influenceable time used for vesting and termination math.
External token transfer to _beneficiary inside withdraw() which can execute untrusted token code.
External token transfer to owner() inside terminate() which can execute untrusted token code.
Constructor parameter supplying the ERC20 token address.
Constructor parameter supplying the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter supplying the vesting start timestamp.
Constructor parameter supplying the vesting duration in days.
Constructor parameter supplying the total benefit amount.
Parameter of transferOwnership and _setOwner giving the new owner address.
Local amount to withdraw computed in withdraw() as releasedBalance - withdrawedBalance.
Local number of elapsed days computed in releasedBalance().
Local total vesting days computed in releasedBalance().
Local amount swept to the owner in terminate().
Local copy of the previous owner in _setOwner used for the event.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to the immutable _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ (rounded to day) is assigned to _releaseStartTime.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ scales the vesting end timestamp stored in _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
block.timestamp is compared against _releaseEndTime in the constructor require, making deployment time-dependent.
Constructor invokes _setOwner via Ownable constructor.
_msgSender() result flows into _setOwner as the initial owner.
msg.sender is returned by _msgSender and becomes the privileged owner identity.
newOwner parameter flows into _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable, the privileged access-control subject.
Current _owner is read into the oldOwner local variable before being overwritten.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner under the onlyOwner guard.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)) under the onlyOwner guard.
transferOwnership uses the newOwner parameter in its validation and transfer.
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with msg.sender, deciding access to privileged functions.
block.timestamp drives all vesting branches in releasedBalance, forming a timestamp dependency.
_releaseStartTime bounds the vesting computation in releasedBalance.
_releaseEndTime bounds the vesting computation in releasedBalance.
_totalBenefit is pro-rated inside releasedBalance.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY is the divisor for the day-based vesting math.
passedDays local variable is computed inside releasedBalance.
totalDays local variable is computed inside releasedBalance.
_totalBenefit is read by unreleasedBalance.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance.
withdraw calls releasedBalance twice to size the payout.
_withdrawedBalance is subtracted when computing the amount local variable.
releasedBalance() result flows into the amount local variable.
amount is added to _withdrawedBalance, mutating state before the external transfer.
withdraw reads _withdrawedBalance for its no-more-benefit check.
withdraw performs the external token safeTransfer unsafe operation.
token() getter result is the target contract of the safeTransfer call.
_beneficiary is the recipient of the withdrawn tokens.
amount local variable is the value transferred in safeTransfer.
External token call can re-enter withdraw(); state is updated before the call but the transfer target is attacker-influenced.
Re-entering withdraw during safeTransfer could attempt to manipulate _withdrawedBalance accounting.
terminate is guarded by onlyOwner which calls owner().
terminate calls releasedBalance to freeze the vested total benefit.
terminate overwrites _totalBenefit with the currently released balance.
terminate overwrites _releaseEndTime with the day-truncated block.timestamp.
terminate sets _isTerminated to true.
block.timestamp determines the new _releaseEndTime in terminate, a timestamp dependency.
terminate reads _withdrawedBalance when computing the amount remaining for the beneficiary.
block.timestamp influences the amountToWithdraw computation in terminate.
amountToWithdraw is the value sent by the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
terminate performs the external token safeTransfer unsafe operation.
token() getter result is the target contract of the terminate safeTransfer.
owner() result is the recipient of the swept unreleased tokens.
External token call inside terminate can re-enter before termination bookkeeping is fully trusted by callers.
Re-entering during the terminate transfer could observe or race the mutated _totalBenefit.
isNotTerminated modifier gates terminate on the _isTerminated flag.
newOwner parameter becomes the privileged _owner through _setOwner, changing access control.

normalization_plan.reason: token_ is a constructor parameter whose value collapses into the constructor assignment of _token.
beneficiary_ is a constructor parameter directly assigned to _beneficiary inside the constructor.
releaseStartTime_ is a constructor parameter normalized into the constructor's _releaseStartTime write.
daysOfTimelock_ is a constructor parameter used only to derive _releaseEndTime in the constructor.
totalBenefit_ is a constructor parameter assigned to _totalBenefit inside the constructor.
newOwner is the parameter of transferOwnership and is consumed by the ownership transfer path.
amount is a withdraw-local temporary derived from releasedBalance and _withdrawedBalance.
passedDays is a local variable computed only inside releasedBalance.
totalDays is a local variable computed only inside releasedBalance.
amountToWithdraw is the local value passed directly into the terminate safeTransfer unsafe operation.
oldOwner is a local temporary read and emitted inside _setOwner.
